name: summon-skills
description: Makes Claude actually use the skills you already have. A local, zero-token matcher reads each prompt and names the 1-3 installed skills that fit it (debugging, planning, TDD, review, wrap-up, your languages and frameworks), process skills first, each at most once per session. Curated routes, filtered against what is installed and enabled; never suggests skills you do not have. Also flags *-lsp plugins that are installed but inert because their language server is missing. Sibling to measure-twice, brief-agents, audit-loose-ends.
